tasks.final_text: The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka. It is located in the oldest remaining Duth building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat ctore for the Duth garrison at the fort.
